MAPerformance on Instagram: "Nissan has confirmed that it is developing a new Skyline, separate from the GTR, and the best news of all, It’s expected to debut soon 🏎️

When asked about the development and styling of the car, Alfonso Albaisa, Nissan’s global design director, stated the Skyline would be "inspired by the past," but not a "retro-styling exercise."

Albaisa added that the car’s design would be "aggressive and modern, with proportions that recall the original." Hence the round tail light design seen in this teaser image. 

While Nissan will not sell the new Skyline in America, an Infiniti performance sedan based on the same platform is expected to be on sale in the United States. 

The Nissan sedan is to feature a tuned version of the automaker's twin-turbocharged 3.0-liter V-6 engine, and is expected to make as much as 450 hp in the US version Infiniti, which will power the rear wheels and feature a manual transmission. The car is planned to slot between the current Z and the GTR. 

We think the teasers look pretty cool, especially that rear quarter shot with the "Skyline" badge on the fender! 

What about all of you? Are you excited to see this thing? 

Source: motor1

#maperformance #nissan #nissanskyline #skyline #jdm"
